name: Short-handed
prompt: The other cook called off. It's you and the owner on the line until close.

choices.text: Keep to your station and call out what you can't cover

outcome.told: You call out what you can't get to, and the owner covers it. It's slow, but nothing goes wrong.

choices.text: Take the grill and the fryer both

outcome.told: You run both stations until close. At the end the owner says you did all right.

failure.told: You fall six tickets behind. The owner takes the fryer back without a word.
